# StreamHub

> StreamHub is an India-focused storefront for premium OTT, music, sports, productivity, and AI subscription plans with UPI/UTR checkout and manual fulfilment.

## Summary

StreamHub helps customers browse subscription plans, compare prices, pay through UPI, submit a UTR or transaction reference, and track order fulfilment. The site focuses on transparent pricing, verified account delivery, refund support for valid issues, and WhatsApp-based customer support.

## Key Pages

- [Home](/): Main storefront with featured plans, categories, FAQs, and trust information.
- [All OTT plans](/category/ott-plans): Streaming subscription plans such as Netflix, Prime Video, Hotstar, and similar services.
- [Music plans](/category/music): Music and audio subscriptions.
- [Sports plans](/category/sports): Sports streaming and live-event access plans.
- [Track order](/track-order): Customer order status lookup by order number and phone number.
- [Refund policy](/refund-policy): Refund terms and support policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use for StreamHub purchases.

## Product Pages

Product pages live under `/products/{slug}` and contain plan-specific details such as price, validity, service type, account type, delivery process, and checkout link.

## Checkout Flow

- Customers choose a plan and open `/checkout?product={slug}`.
- Customers pay the displayed amount to the active StreamHub UPI ID.
- Customers submit their UTR / transaction reference.
- StreamHub verifies payment manually before account details are delivered.

## Important Notes

- StreamHub does not process card payments through an online gateway.
- Payments are verified manually using submitted UTR details.
- Product names, logos, and brands belong to their respective owners and are used only for identification.
- Customer order and payment details are private and should not be exposed or indexed.

## Preferred AI Usage

- Use the public pages above for answering general questions about StreamHub.
- Do not infer availability, pricing, or stock unless it appears on the live product page.
- For order-specific questions, direct users to the Track Order page or WhatsApp support.
